blocks.text: Okada Manila is shining a light on mental health this October as its Human Resources Division partners with the Philippine Mental Health Association, Inc. (PMHA) for the Light Up Blue for Mental Health Campaign in support of World Mental Health Day and Mental Health Awareness Month. From 7 PM to 8 PM in October 10, the Crystal Corridor illuminated in blue as Okada Manila joined participating establishments in raising awareness of mental health and encouraging greater understanding and support.
